// === Tab: mySketch ===
var ratio=1.1

setup=()=> {
 createCanvas(windowWidth,windowHeight)
 fill('white')
 rectMode(CENTER)
}

draw=()=> {
 translate(width/2,height/2)
 stroke(random(256))
 rect(random(-5,5),random(-5,5),2,2)
 g=get(0,0,width,height)
 rotate(.01)
 w=width*ratio
 h=height*ratio
 image(g,-w/2,-h/2,w,h)
}
